reviews.title: Wonderful app
reviews.text:
I used to love this app… but… everything’s gone… will my gallery, my prompts, my friends, ever come back? I miss my friends! I do see some hope because the app is allowing me to make beautiful images again…. but it’s so sad without Woffort and Elemc and everyone!!!! Please let us know what is happening❣️

A few months have gone by…. So now it’s August 2025. It looks like the gallery and friends are never coming back. I lost images because I thought I could let them be stored in the app. I can’t give 5 stars anymore because this app is not what it used to be 🥲

So still grateful but awfully sad.

If I had created a brilliant app like this, I would have nurtured it and appreciated every subscriber as a precious gift. The beauty of what it was is a great loss to those of us who  loved it.

A year has gone by. I have a premium subscription but Wombo won’t let me use animation. It wants me to buy credits for $19.99. I don’t get it. No response to my queries. This time I’ve cancelled my subscription and it will expire some time next year.

reviews.title: Used to be a great App
reviews.text:
Latest: Global malfunction. Zero communication again. 

Last time: Sadly the image quality has been degraded once again. More variety much lower quality. Same old plastic look on most images that tells you its Wombo Dream. Sharpness and superb textures equal to Midjourney have been replaced with a vastly inferior image quality we had 2 years ago which by today’s standard is just embarrassingly poor. Plus the absurd restrictions and censorship are back and worse than ever. Really disappointing and a predictable cycle of improvement followed by “let’s screw it up again”. Really disappointing and I’d recommend going elsewhere at this stage.

Previously…
Update on new iOS build: v4 styles are now working in all formats, which is great. Dark mode now works, so things are getting better and for once I don’t feel like I have to moan about an app that I really like. Good job! Extra star. 

Last review: v4 styles are great but not working for all formats (no change here since launching them). And of course the app is not connecting to the server once again currently. Zero response & zero pro-activity, as we’ve all come to expect. Not even bothering to say “we’re aware & working on it” hugely damages their reputation. Could be down for a day, or down for a month like the last fiasco.

reviews.title: You still lose your credits for failed video generations.
reviews.text:
I paid the $20 to unlock video creation, and it occasionally works, and of the times it works, it occasionally looks good. But the vast majority of my generations will fail due to “content restrictions”, and I’m not even trying to generate anything inappropriate, it’s just that when the AI DECIDES to interpret my prompts as something inappropriate and it sets of its own filtering system, it causes the failure. And it still took the time to generate the whole thing, so I still lose the credits I paid for! If it’s generated from a photo with no text prompt, it will create its own prompt, and will make up vulgar things that aren’t even suggested in the reference image. It’s insane. I feel like I’m being punished because the AI model is a pervert. And to add insult to injury, the app says the output “cant be viewed on mobile”, and displays a button that says “click here”, which does nothing. When you go to your account on a desktop computer and view the gallery. It still doesn’t display the video. It feels extremely scammy. 

Furthermore, it honestly shouldn’t matter if a user wants to generate certain content, since they removed the public gallery and all social aspects of the previous iteration of the app. So who would the user be offending, themselves? 

I’ve used this app for a while now, and it seems like the feature set gets stunted more and more as the updates roll out, and then if we’re lucky we get a couple new styles once a year or so, half of which are boring and usele
